definitions.gloss: not only… but also; let alone
definitions.explanation: Joins two things and adds the second as more surprising or more extreme than the first: X ばかりか Y も. Follows a noun or the plain form of a verb or adjective. Often with a negative: X ばかりか Y もない (not only not X but not even Y). Written and somewhat formal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧ばかりか⟦{中国語|ちゅうごくご}→中国語：10966_chuugokugo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{話|はな}せる→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: He speaks not only English but Chinese too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧ばかりか⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた。
examples.english: Not only the rain but also the wind has grown stronger.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{効|き}かない→効く：01932_kiku⟧ばかりか、⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Not only did the medicine not work, it even caused side effects.

notes:
Built from ⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧ (only) + the question particle ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧. The second clause usually carries ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧, ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧, or ⟦さえ→さえ：32259_sae⟧. It describes facts, so it is not used before a command or request in the second clause.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Noun + ばかりか + Noun + ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: not only X but also Y
- Verb (plain) + ばかりか: not only does…
- 〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ばかりか: not only does not…, but even

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧: not only… but also — the everyday equivalent, neutral in tone
- どころか: far from, let alone — can reject the first part outright (far from X, actually Y), which ばかりか never does
